contexts.text: In the ultimate of order, in which all things are relatively circumstanced inconstantly.
The state of man's life... is inconstant.
If man concludes from effects and their inconstancies...
The things of more interior nature, where they do not go so inconstantly, but more constantly. From constancies in the inmosts, indefinite inconstancies come forth, by degrees, in the lowest things.
In interiors flowing... constantly... but in exteriors... as it were inconstantly... Hence it comes to pass that such various inconstancies appear in exterior things...
